mapper.update: update region_daily_stat set sido_name = #{sidoName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, `name` = #{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, total_sites = #{totalSites,jdbcType=INTEGER}, total_target = #{totalTarget,jdbcType=INTEGER}, completed_target = #{completedTarget,jdbcType=INTEGER}, total_reports = #{totalReports,jdbcType=INTEGER}, completed_reports = #{completedReports,jdbcType=INTEGER}, pending_reports = #{pendingReports,jdbcType=INTEGER}, issue_reports_count = #{issueReportsCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, create_time = #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} where stat_date = #{statDate,jdbcType=DATE} and region_id = #{regionId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: select stat_date, region_id, sido_name, `name`, total_sites, total_target, completed_target, total_reports, completed_reports, pending_reports, issue_reports_count, create_time from region_daily_stat
mapper.insert: insert into region_daily_stat ( stat_date, region_id, sido_name, `name`, total_sites, total_target, completed_target, total_reports, completed_reports, pending_reports, issue_reports_count, create_time ) select #{statDate,jdbcType=DATE} as stat_date, fr.region_id, fr.sido_name, fr.name, coalesce(s_agg.total_sites, 0) as total_sites, coalesce(s_agg.total_target, 0) as total_target, coalesce(s_agg.completed_target, 0) as completed_target, coalesce(r_agg.total_reports, 0) as total_reports, coalesce(r_agg.completed_reports, 0) as completed_reports, coalesce(r_agg.pending_reports, 0) as pending_reports, coalesce(r_agg.issue_reports_count, 0) as issue_reports_count, now() as create_time from fire_region fr left join ( select s.region_id, count(distinct s.site_id) as total_sites, count(h.household_id) as total_target, count(distinct case when wr.status = 'COMPLETED' and wr.delete_flg = 0 then h.household_id end) as completed_target from site s left join household h on s.site_id = h.site_id left join work_report wr on h.household_id = wr.household_id and wr.delete_flg = 0 and wr.status = 'COMPLETED' where s.region_id is not null and s.region_id != '' group by s.region_id ) s_agg on fr.region_id = s_agg.region_id left join ( select s.region_id, count(*) as total_reports, count(case when wr.status = 'COMPLETED' then 1 end) as completed_reports, count(case when wr.status = 'PENDING' then 1 end) as pending_reports, count(case when wr.status = 'PENDING' and wr.remarks is not null and trim(wr.remarks) != '' and wr.remarks not like '%특이사항 없음%' then 1 end) as issue_reports_count from work_report wr join site s on wr.site_id = s.site_id where wr.delete_flg = 0 and s.region_id is not null and s.region_id != '' group by s.region_id ) r_agg on fr.region_id = r_agg.region_id on duplicate key update sido_name = values(sido_name), `name` = values(`name`), total_sites = values(total_sites), total_target = values(total_target), completed_target = values(completed_target), total_reports = values(total_reports), completed_reports = values(completed_reports), pending_reports = values(pending_reports), issue_reports_count = values(issue_reports_count), create_time = values(create_time)
mapper.select: select rds.stat_date, rds.region_id, rds.sido_name, rds.`name`, rds.total_sites, rds.total_target, rds.completed_target, rds.total_reports, rds.completed_reports, rds.pending_reports, rds.issue_reports_count, rds.create_time from region_daily_stat rds inner join ( select region_id, max(stat_date) as max_stat_date from region_daily_stat where stat_date >= #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} and stat_date <= #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} group by region_id ) latest on rds.region_id = latest.region_id and rds.stat_date = latest.max_stat_date order by rds.sido_name asc, rds.`name` asc
